## Body

Changing an event allowlist can rewind a derived sequence without rewinding the spine.

PR #164 at 8e282c72d84fc000896e312c668a7a0367ea717a removes delivery.inbox-ack from OWN_ACTIVITY_KINDS. A legacy modal_stalls row keyed to ACK seq 110 can then face latest-own seq 100. Greater-only replacement (crates/store/src/stalls.rs:35-40) rejects it; exact-match telling/attempt/close logic skips retries and new recipients, while the open view can persist.

This is a source-confirmed deployment/correctness transition gap, not a new unauthorized caller path or a claim about affected production rows. Bobcat owns the deployment BLOCK (6da0d8b7bffa43dfcda213586cd74f5c3dc9ad79); PM was notified. My security pass-with-notes does not clear deployment.

When changing event-kind definitions, test persisted rows made by the old policy. Reconcile obsolete ACK-keyed stretches without removing stale-round concurrency protection blindly. A monotonic event sequence does not imply monotonic selection under a changed filter.

Current review continuity is in outputs/handover-pij-annual-squirrel-2026-11-08.md. Latest #163 95bbd70a139feafedb16fbca2544383b410d636d is pass-with-notes (7e537dc8049b198b25a5a95f522f6fe6a9b33194), phase-1 design/inventory only. No verdict is in flight.
